caveats.category_estimate: The category total is an approximate rollup from session records.
caveats.cooccurrence_not_influence: Knowledge-graph co-occurrence is not treated as proof of social influence.
caveats.curated_milestones: The narrative selects representative milestones rather than every archived event.
caveats.currency_context: Currency values retain their original period and are not inflation- or exchange-rate-adjusted.
caveats.derived_average: Calculated from the monthly values in the cited annual source.
caveats.employment_dates_self_reported: Employment dates come from first-party career documents.
caveats.excerpted_quote: The quote is shortened for display without changing its meaning.
caveats.feedback_respondents_only: Ratings describe respondents, not every attendee.
caveats.future_direction: This describes an active direction, not a promised or completed outcome.
caveats.inclusive_year_count: The span counts calendar years inclusively from 2007 through 2026.
caveats.initiative_specific: The metric belongs to the cited initiative and should not be generalized to all work.
caveats.light_grammar_edit: Minor grammar was normalized for display; the source preserves the original wording.
caveats.mixed_attribution: The record combines personal contribution with shared delivery context.
caveats.mixed_evidence_tiers: The claim combines sources with different evidentiary strength.
caveats.narrative_synthesis: This is an interpretation across multiple sources, not a single source claim.
caveats.participant_counts_not_unique: Participant totals are session instances and may include repeat attendees.
caveats.period_specific: The value applies only to the stated year or period.
caveats.pilot_not_scaled_outcome: A pilot or proposal demonstrates direction, not enterprise-scale adoption.
caveats.population_not_active_users: The figure describes the addressable software community, not measured active users.
caveats.portfolio_attribution: The outcome belongs to a portfolio of initiatives rather than one project or person alone.
caveats.public_citation_index: Patent counts and citations are based on the archived public-reference index.
caveats.public_safe_aggregate: Names, personal contribution amounts, account details, and identifiers are intentionally excluded.
caveats.responses_not_attendance: Feedback responses are not the same as total attendance.
caveats.selected_evidence: Recommendations and quotations are curated, not an unbiased survey.
caveats.self_reported: The figure is reported in a first-party resume or work narrative.
caveats.team_attribution: The result is a team outcome; Datta's role is contribution and leadership, not sole credit.
caveats.touchpoints_not_unique_people: Participant touchpoints may include the same person more than once.
